    data = b''

    p = subprocess.run([RUN], input=data, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=180)
    assert p.returncode == 0, (p.returncode, p.stderr[-2000:])
    out = [json.loads(l) for l in p.stdout.decode().splitlines()]
